text:
MPC rose 2.8% today, recovering some ground after a sharp decline over the past week. The bounce came as U.S. crude oil fell below $100 a barrel on news of U.S.-Iran diplomatic efforts, which reduced immediate geopolitical risk in the Middle East. For a refiner like Marathon, lower oil prices can improve margins—the spread between what crude costs to buy and what refined products sell for—though the broader oil market has been volatile, with the stock down nearly 7% over two weeks as uncertainty weighs on the sector.

Refineries are running at 92.8% capacity with healthy inventory levels, so operational conditions remain solid. The recent leadership change and company update announced this week may also be generating renewed investor interest, though the fundamental driver today appears to be the diplomatic de-escalation in the Middle East easing near-term supply concerns.
